name: Northridge Fashion Center
description: Northridge Fashion Center is a premier two-level shopping destination in the heart of the San Fernando Valley, offering an exceptional mix of high-quality retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. Anchored by major department stores including Macy's, JCPenney, and Nordstrom, this Simon property features over 180 specialty stores ranging from popular fashion brands to unique local boutiques. With its convenient location and diverse tenant mix, Northridge Fashion Center serves as the primary retail hub for the surrounding communities.
